description:
## Problem
The old generator (direct-to-warehouse tables, one batch, independent keys), its direct load, the old Python and DataFrame ETL and TPCDIMetrics (not the specification's formula) are unreachable since the quarantine.

## Owner decisions (choice dialogs, 2026-11-20)
- "the BenchBox generator and its direct-to-warehouse load are deleted once the DIGen path passes" as amended: "delete only after the DuckDB historical load passes its audit" and "lands only after you have seen the milestone report".
- "The old `enable_parallel` and `max_workers` TPC-DI options are removed."
- "The `benchbox[tpcdi]` extra (pandas) is removed with the old generator unless the new code needs it."
- "Public Python members of `TPCDI` and `TPCDIBenchmark` that only served the old path are removed; the list is shown in that pull request's description and the breaking changelog entry."

## Change
Plan S7. Delete generator/, generator_specs.yaml, scaling.py, financial_data.py, loader.py, source_generators.py, etl/, the old validation.py and metrics.py, the old sections of benchmark.py, the facade methods in benchbox/tpcdi.py, the old DataFrame path, their tests, the pyproject and api-public-symbols entries, and the matching rows of docs/internal/tpc-measured-intervals.md. Breaking changelog fragment.

## Decision gates
The removed public member list and the changelog text are shown in the pull request description. If the new code needs pandas, keep the extra and say why.

## Verification rubric
Pass: `rg -n 'TPCDIDataGenerator|source_generators|run_etl_pipeline|DataFrameETLBackend|TPCDIMetrics' benchbox tests` prints nothing; `make duplicate-check-delta` and `make pr-preflight` pass; step 12's integration test still passes.

## Guardrails (owner, 2026-11-20)
- The agent never posts a stand-in review, closes and reopens a pull request to restart CI, uses `--no-verify`, force-pushes, rewrites an author, or deletes anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`.
- Arming: `make pr-arm` once; one more attempt only when the refusal named a cause, the agent reported it and the cause is cleared; never a third without asking. `make pr-rerun` at most once and only for a job the runner never ran or cancelled, never for a failed test.
- Review threads: reply; resolve only after the bot's review of the new head does not raise the finding again.
- Subagents are read-only. No file edit by script; use the edit tool. Do not edit a pull request description while its CI is starting; post a comment.
- Any limit, default, threshold, status token, message or label text the owner has not already chosen (see tpcdi-correction-plan-20261120) is shown to the owner before it is committed.
- A blocked step stops this item; no workaround. No live cloud run. Heavy work only through `make heavy-run`. One pull request for this item, merged before the next item starts.
- From the quarantine step until the reopening step, no TPC-DI entry point may produce a result that reads PASSED or is admitted for publication.
